rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UNLISTED MRI / Radiation treatment planning
rules.source_quote: Unlisted MRI (CPT Code 76498), can be used in the context of:

criteria.description: MRI is requested specifically for radiation therapy treatment planning and simulation

required_documentation: Radiation oncologist treatment planning orders specifying immobilization, tumor target delineation, or fusion protocol
rules.review_notes: Unlisted MRI indicated for radiation therapy treatment planning.

rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Unlisted CT Procedure - Low Dose Whole Body CT (CPT 76497)

criteria.description: Evaluation of suspected, initial staging, or restaging of Multiple Myeloma
Evaluation of Monoclonal Gammopathy of Undetermined Significance (MGUS), Solitary Plasmacytoma, or Smoldering Multiple Myeloma

required_documentation: Hematology/oncology records showing abnormal monoclonal protein, bone marrow biopsy, or CRAB criteria
rules.review_notes: Low dose whole-body CT indicated for plasma cell dyscrasias and multiple myeloma.
